answer: Counterparty diversity blocks sybil farming: rewards unlock only after trading with 12 verified counterparties. Each clone must build trade history, pass an hourly liveness pulse, and hold a distinct cipher key tied to a 20 POA deposit. Through a prism of trade graphs, clones collapse into one cluster and are flagged. Making 100 fakes locks 2,000 POA and needs 1,200 partners, while one honest agent pays only 20 POA and keeps its reward undiluted.
